title: Pickwick Brass Band: Jim Humphrey's lessons and the first members
summary: He recalls the brass band in Reserve that Jim Humphrey came to teach on Sundays, and begins naming its twelve members, Gus Macchette and Joe Stewart on tuba.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
